title: Pin SHA-256 for Mechanic Lua restore download
description: Add pinned SHA-256 verification for the SourceForge Lua 5.1.5 zip downloaded by scripts/restore-mechanic-lua.ps1 so bootstrap cannot install tampered binaries when Mechanic's lua.exe download fails.
design:
### Stubs Committed
(none — script hardening only)

### Design Forks Resolved
- **Verify zip vs binaries**: Pin SHA-256 of the downloaded `.zip` before extract (single check point; matches curl download boundary).
- **URL stability**: Keep SourceForge direct URL; hash pins content even if redirects change (document if URL must change, recompute hash).
- **MechanicRoot param**: Reuse existing `$MechanicRoot` param; no new CLI surface.

### Skills to Load
- `tooling-platform/subskill/platform-reliability/subskill/security` — pinned artifact verification
- `tooling-platform/subskill/developer-tooling/subskill/just` — validate `just restore-lua` and `just bootstrap`
- `docs/mechanic-setup.md` — cross-check documented Lua restore workaround

### Context Refs
- `docs/mechanic-setup.md` — Windows Lua restore when `mech setup` downloads bad file
- `justfile` — `restore-lua` recipe invokes `scripts/restore-mechanic-lua.ps1`
- CodeRabbit PR #1 discussion: `scripts/restore-mechanic-lua.ps1` lines 12–29

### Affected Files
- `scripts/restore-mechanic-lua.ps1` — add `$expectedSha256`, verify after curl, fail before extract
- `docs/mechanic-setup.md` — optional one-line note that archive hash is pinned (if behavior changes for maintainers)
acceptance_criteria:
1. Given a clean Windows dev machine with Mechanic bootstrap prerequisites, When `just restore-lua` downloads `lua-5.1.5_Win64_bin.zip`, Then `Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256` on the zip matches a pinned `$expectedSha256` constant before `Expand-Archive`.
2. Given a tampered or wrong archive (hash mismatch), When the restore script runs, Then it deletes the downloaded zip, throws a clear error, and does not copy `lua.exe` or `lua5.1.dll` into Mechanic's `desktop/bin`.
3. Given a valid archive, When restore completes, Then existing PE header check and `lua -v` version output still pass and `just bootstrap` / `just test` remain green.
4. Given the pinned hash in source, When a maintainer reads `scripts/restore-mechanic-lua.ps1`, Then a comment documents where the SHA-256 was obtained (URL, date, verification steps).
notes: Deferred from PR #1 CodeRabbit review (2026-06-12). Hash must be computed from a trusted download on a clean machine, not a placeholder.

title: Pin GitHub Actions to commit SHAs (repo-wide)
description: Pin every third-party GitHub Actions uses: ref in .github/workflows/ to immutable commit SHAs so CI supply-chain checks (zizmor unpinned-uses) pass repo-wide, not only in test.yml.
design:
### Stubs Committed
(none — config-only hardening; no new code interfaces)

### Design Forks Resolved
- **Scope**: Pin all third-party `uses:` refs in `.github/workflows/` (not only `test.yml`), so zizmor/unpinned-uses policy is consistent repo-wide.
- **Bump strategy**: Manual SHA lookup per action release for now; optional follow-up bead for Renovate/Dependabot action pinning.
- **Checkout hardening**: `persist-credentials: false` already landed on `test.yml` in PR #1; apply same on other workflows that use `actions/checkout` when pinning.

### Skills to Load
- `tooling-platform/subskill/platform-reliability/subskill/security` — supply-chain pinning patterns
- `tooling-platform/subskill/developer-tooling/subskill/just` — run `just check` after workflow edits if applicable
- `ce-framework-docs-researcher` — resolve current commit SHAs for each action major version

### Context Refs
- `AGENTS.md` — dev workflow and CI expectations
- CodeRabbit PR #1 discussion: `.github/workflows/test.yml` lines 12–21 (unpinned-uses + artipacked)

### Affected Files
- `.github/workflows/test.yml` — `actions/checkout@v6`, `actions/setup-python@v5`
- `.github/workflows/changesets.yml` — `actions/checkout@v6`, `oven-sh/setup-bun@v2`
- `.github/workflows/version-packages.yml` — `actions/checkout@v6`, `oven-sh/setup-bun@v2`, `changesets/action@v1`
- `.github/workflows/release.yml` — `actions/checkout@v6`, `BigWigsMods/packager@v2`
acceptance_criteria:
1. Given any workflow under `.github/workflows/`, When an agent audits `uses:` references, Then every third-party action (actions/*, oven-sh/*, changesets/*, BigWigsMods/*) is pinned to a full commit SHA, not a `@vN` tag.
2. Given the updated workflows, When CI runs on a PR touching workflow files, Then Test, Changesets, Version Packages, and Release jobs complete successfully.
3. Given pinned SHAs are in place, When a maintainer reads workflow comments or `docs/agents/`, Then there is a one-line note on how to bump pins safely (manual lookup or future bot).
notes: Deferred from PR #1 CodeRabbit review (2026-06-12). persist-credentials: false already merged on test.yml; this bead covers SHA pinning only.
